title: Lernumi tool package manifest
description: Manifest stored as /tool.json at the root of every uploaded tool ZIP.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the tool.json document shape. This is not the runtime API version.

code.description: Stable tool identifier. It must match the Tool record receiving the upload.

version.description: Immutable semantic version of this package.

entry.description: Safe relative path to the single HTML entry point inside the ZIP.
